title: Main Quest

{{Terminology Infobox |image = Icon Main Quests.png |type = Quest Types }} '''Main Quests''' are the primary set of [[quests]] that tell the main story of [[Rover]]. The main story is divided into Chapters, which are divided further into Acts. Players need to reach a certain [[Union Level]] to unlock each act in the storyline.
